references.text: Timnah is also mentioned in connection with the borders of Judah, which shows the city's geographical location in the region of Judah.
Timnah is mentioned in the story of Judah and Tamar, where Judah went to Timnah to shear his sheep.
Timnah is mentioned as the place where Samson met a Philistine woman he wanted to marry.
Cain is mentioned in the genealogy as a city built by Enoch, which may be linked to the place name Hakkayin.
Gibeah (Gibea) is mentioned as a city in the tribe of Benjamin, a similar location reference as Gibeah in Judah.
